demos.name: AI Demo Standalone
demos.description: A mock of the AI-DEMO2 dashboard: all 87 use cases in one catalog, run against one mock PDP (token, gateway, policy, then HITL obligations). 31 run in-app - foundations, attacks (token theft, takeover, bad client), controls (overscoped tokens, gateway search filter, public tools), HITL (step-up, consent, CIBA) and A2A hand-off - with evidence views (chain map, token cards, demo hops, receipts), a scripted assistant, a talk track and Quick Config; the other tracks open their shelf lab. Mock only; Real is reserved.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7810). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7810 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Catalog id D128.
